VI.description: Stand-in for an FPGA FIFO Read node with the handshake interface (FIFO In\2C Ready for Output -> Element\2C Output Valid\2C FIFO Out) so that a VI using it can be round-tripped through AIXML. The FIFO's configuration is given as constants on the diagram\3A FIFO Name (the FIFO item in the LabVIEW project) and Data Type (the element type); Element is a Variant (convert with Variant To Data in the caller). On My Computer it passes FIFO In to FIFO Out and reports Output Valid = FALSE with an empty Element. In the FPGA VI\2C replace each call with the real FIFO Method Node for FIFO Name and delete the constants.

FreeLabel.comment: Stand-in for FPGA FIFO Read (handshake). Configuration is the FIFO Name / Data Type constants wired by the caller.
